scripts.build: bun run clean && bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun build src/project/evaluator-sdk-entry.ts --target=bun --format=esm --outfile=dist/internal/project-evaluator-sdk.bundle.js && cp ../../docs/spec/machine/project-authoring-1.schema.json dist/project-authoring-1.schema.json
scripts.clean: bun -e "import { rm } from 'node:fs/promises'; await rm('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.test:linux-cgroup: bun run build && sh ../../scripts/preflight-linux-cgroup.sh && JIG_TEST_PYTHON="$(command -v python3)" JIG_TEST_NIX_STORE="$(command -v nix-store)" JIG_LINUX_CGROUP_HOSTILE=1 bun test test/linux-cgroup-backend.test.ts --timeout 120000
